title: Behavioral, Leadership & Engineering Practices
intro: Behavioral interviews are graded on structure, not answers. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the STAR method (the framework every behavioral answer should use), then the pressure questions (delivering under pressure, failure and learning — the 'tell me about a time' canon), then interpersonal (conflict resolution), then forward-looking (career growth). It closes with agile and scrum — the process questions that round out a behavioral round.
